tvShow.name: The Artful Dodger
tvShow.overview: It's a tale of reinvention, betrayal, redemption, and love with a twist. Jack Dawkins is The Artful Dodger, whose pickpocketing fingers have become the skilled hands of a surgeon. He is torn between an impossible love and the criminal underworld he secretly craves. This will require Artfulness.

episodes.name: The Yankee Dodge
episodes.overview: With a huge gambling debt, coinciding with the return of Fagin, Dodger agrees to a final sting.

episodes.name: Blessings of St. Coccyx
episodes.overview: Trying to steal 500 sovereigns, Dodger and Fagin witness Darius in a compromising position.

episodes.name: Dead Men's Secrets
episodes.overview: With Gaines planning their demise, the pressure is on Dodger and Fagin to find the missing money.

episodes.name: The Stitch Up
episodes.overview: Fagin serves up Gaines' wife and Darius. Sneed attacks Dodger at the Governor's dinner.

episodes.name: The Duel
episodes.overview: Fagin plots to swap a valuable barrel with a fake. Sneed and Dodger's rivalry culminates in a duel.

episodes.name: Bully in the Alley
episodes.overview: Gaines plans to rid the colony of crime. Red is captured and must undergo emergency surgery.

episodes.name: Wet Lettuce
episodes.overview: Fagin and Dodger attempt a risky heist in pursuit of gold. Belle reveals her secret to Jack.

episodes.name: Untapped Potential
episodes.overview: Jack attempts to save Belle but is betrayed and arrested by Gaines.

episodes.name: Hangman
episodes.overview: Jack has a date with the noose. Will Belle and Fagin be able to help our hero dodge his fate?

episodes.name: Entry Level Toff
episodes.overview: Belle and Jack find themselves up to their elbows in blood and trouble.

episodes.name: Belle of the Ball
episodes.overview: As Boxer closes in, Jack gatecrashes the masquerade ball to steal a dance with Lady Belle.

episodes.name: Platinum
episodes.overview: Belle finds herself out of her depth while Fagin and Dodger plot to steal something priceless.

episodes.name: Ice Melts
episodes.overview: Belle and Jack's secretive romance comes under threat and Fagin's enemy prepares to strike.

episodes.name: Bellybutton
episodes.overview: A revelation threatens Belle and Jack's romance, before a strange surgery forces them together.

episodes.name: Salt Peter
episodes.overview: An explosive scheme is hatched, Belle and Jack race against time to find a cure for cholera.

episodes.name: Change of Heart
episodes.overview: Lady Jane's secret shocks Belle to her core, Fagin considers a drastic way out of his predicament.
